policy: Prefer shipped CC0/public-domain assets; every external asset must record source and license before shipping.

characters.source: Quaternius Universal Base Characters Standard (bundled/audited by Seyamalam/blood-league-kickoff)

runtimeRules: Normalize imported characters to measured world height.
Use PBR materials with realistic roughness/metalness.
Use LOD for expensive near-field geometry.
Keep gameplay collision geometry independent from render geometry.
Do not ship an asset unless its license/source is recorded here.
